note: The drafting queue, in the repo so the workflow needs no database and no Cloudflare token. Oldest first is next up. Dedup history is NOT mirrored here: it is read from src/content/articles/*.md, which is the only place that cannot drift out of step with what is actually published. Topics are deliberately anchored to tools with stable official documentation — Python's stdlib, git, VS Code, ffmpeg, Microsoft Learn — because nine of the blocked drafts died on documentation URLs the model invented or that had moved. A topic whose canonical doc page has sat at the same URL for years is a topic a model can cite honestly. Categories are interleaved so a day's five articles are not all from one section.
